verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity offers a manual 'add to blocklist' review tool to block future verifications with the same document, and recommends limiting repeat verification attempts per user, showing some duplicate-detection capability — but this is manual/document-based, not an automatic system that flags the same face or document resurfacing under a different name. Missing for 10: evidence of automated biometric/face-matching across identities, cross-name duplicate detection, or any documentation describing this as an automatic risk-analyst-facing flagging feature.
